# Goals of this document

I am trying to keep fewer steps within each document. So the goal of this document is JUST to use beta diversity measures to produce ordinations and hierarchical dendrograms. There will be a separate document (Compositional Analysis) where I spend time parsing through taxonomic composition of our samples. 

# Load Data and Packages

```{r load-packages}

pacman::p_load(phyloseq, ggdendro, dendextend, vegan, patchwork, fun.gus, GUniFrac, tidyverse)

source("code/R/plotting_aesthetics.R")

load("data/08_Beta_Diversity/trim_physeq.RData")

load("data/08_Beta_Diversity/bray_dendro.RData")

trim_melted <- 
  trim_physeq %>%
  psmelt()

```

# Exploring correlation of pigment classes and cyanobacterial groups

```{r cyano-cors}

top_10_fam <- 
  trim_melted %>%
  dplyr::filter(Phylum == "p__Cyanobacteriota", !is.na(Family)) %>%
  group_by(Family) %>%
  summarize(Count = max(Abundance)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  slice_max(order_by = Count, n = 10) %>%
  pull(Family)

cors <- trim_melted %>%
  dplyr::filter(Phylum == "p__Cyanobacteriota", Family %in% top_10_fam) %>%
  group_by(Sample_ID, Family) %>%
  summarize(Count = sum(Abundance),
            Total_Chl = mean(total_chl_counts),
            Big_Chl = mean(pig_counts_chl_big),
            Small_Chl = mean(pig_counts_chl_small),
            High_chl_no_pe = mean(pig_counts_high_chl_no_pe),
            Low_chl_no_pe = mean(pig_counts_low_chl_no_pe),
            High_chl_high_pe = mean(pig_counts_high_chl_high_pe)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Family) %>%
  summarize(cor_to_total_chl = cor(Total_Chl, Count),
            cor_to_big_chl = cor(Big_Chl, Count),
            cor_to_small_chl = cor(Small_Chl, Count),
            cor_to_hcnp = cor(High_chl_no_pe, Count),
            cor_to_lcnp = cor(Low_chl_no_pe, Count),
            cor_to_hchp = cor(High_chl_high_pe, Count))

cors %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = cor_to_small_chl, y = cor_to_big_chl, label = Family)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_label() + 
  coord_equal(xlim = c(0,1), ylim = c(0,1)) + 
  labs(x = "Correlation to Small Chl Counts", y = "Correlation to Big Chl Counts")

cors %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = cor_to_hcnp, y = cor_to_lcnp, label = Family)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_label() + 
  coord_equal(xlim = c(0,1), ylim = c(0,1))

cors %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = cor_to_total_chl, y = cor_to_hchp, label = Family)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_label() + 
  coord_equal(xlim = c(0,1), ylim = c(0,1))


cors %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = cor_to_total_chl, y = cor_to_big_chl, label = Family)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_label() + 
  coord_equal(xlim = c(0,1), ylim = c(0,1))

cors %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = cor_to_total_chl, y = cor_to_small_chl, label = Family)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_label() + 
  coord_equal(xlim = c(0,1), ylim = c(0,1))

trim_melted %>%
  select(pig_counts_chl_big, pig_counts_chl_small) %>%
  unique() %>%
  cor()

trim_melted %>%
  select(pig_counts_chl_big, pig_counts_chl_small, total_chl_counts) %>%
  unique() %>%
  cor()

```

A vast majority of total chl counts are "small" counts.

# Exploring Stacked Bar Plots

```{r stacked-bar-plots, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 12}

dna_id_order <-  ggdendro::dendro_data(bray_dendro)$label$label

sample_annotation <- 
  trim_melted %>%
  select(DNA_ID, Station_ID, Month, Basin, Bray_Group) %>%
  unique() %>%
  mutate(DNA_ID = factor(DNA_ID, levels = dna_id_order))

basin_plot <- sample_annotation %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=1, y = DNA_ID)) + 
  geom_tile(aes(fill = Basin)) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = basin_colors, name = "Basin") + 
  theme_void()+ 
  theme(legend.position = "left")

month_plot <- sample_annotation %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=1, y = DNA_ID)) + 
  geom_tile(aes(fill = Month)) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = month_colors, name = "Month") + 
  theme_void()+ 
  theme(legend.position = "left")

group_plot <- sample_annotation %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = 1, y = DNA_ID)) + 
  geom_tile(aes(fill = Bray_Group)) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors, name = "Group") + 
  theme_void() + 
  theme(legend.position = "left")

barplot <- trim_melted %>%
  mutate(DNA_ID = factor(DNA_ID, levels = dna_id_order)) %>%
  group_by(DNA_ID, Class) %>%
  summarize(Class_Abund = sum(Abundance)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Class) %>%
  mutate(Class = ifelse(max(Class_Abund) > 90000, Class, "(Rare)"),
         Class = str_remove(Class, "c__")) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Class_Abund, y = DNA_ID, fill = Class)) + 
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = class_colors) + 
  labs(x = "Absolute Abundance") + 
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y= element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y= element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin()) + 
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0))

group_plot + month_plot  + basin_plot + barplot +
  plot_layout(nrow = 1, 
              widths = c(1,1,1, 16),
              guides = "collect") & 
  theme(legend.position = "left")

```


```{r just-cyanos}

cy_barplot <- trim_melted %>%
  mutate(DNA_ID = factor(DNA_ID, levels = dna_id_order)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Phylum == "p__Cyanobacteriota") %>%
  group_by(DNA_ID, Family) %>%
  summarize(Fam_Abund = sum(Abundance)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Family) %>% 
  mutate(Family = ifelse(max(Fam_Abund) > 3000, Family, "(Rare)"),
         Family = str_remove(Family, "f__")) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Fam_Abund, y = DNA_ID, fill = Family)) + 
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cyano_family_colors) + 
  labs(x = "Absolute Abundance") + 
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y= element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y= element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin()) + 
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0))

group_plot + month_plot  + basin_plot + cy_barplot +
  plot_layout(nrow = 1, 
              widths = c(1,1,1, 16),
              guides = "collect") & 
  theme(legend.position = "left")

```

Now using our grouping by cyanos specifically

```{r Figure3b, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 8}

load("data/08_Beta_Diversity/cyano_physeq.RData")

load("data/08_Beta_Diversity/cy_dendro.RData")

cy_order <- ggdendro::dendro_data(cy_dendro)$label$label

cy_melt <- cyano_physeq %>%
  psmelt()

cy_annotation <- 
  cy_melt %>%
  select(DNA_ID, Cy_Group, Month, Basin) %>%
  unique() %>%
  mutate(DNA_ID = factor(DNA_ID, levels = rev(cy_order)),
         Cy_Group_Name = case_when(
           Cy_Group == 1 ~ "Deep Desert",
           Cy_Group == 2 ~ "Peak Bloom",
           Cy_Group == 3 ~ "Eastern Basin",
           Cy_Group == 4 ~ "Sep. Central Basin",
           Cy_Group == 5 ~ "Bloom Adjacent 2",
           Cy_Group == 6 ~ "Aug. Central Basin",
           Cy_Group == 7 ~ "Bloom Adjacent 1"),
         Cy_Group_Name = factor(Cy_Group_Name,
                                levels = c(
                                  "Deep Desert",
                                  "Peak Bloom",
                                  "Bloom Adjacent 1",
                                  "Bloom Adjacent 2",
                                  "Sep. Central Basin",
                                  "Aug. Central Basin",
                                  "Eastern Basin"
                                ))) %>%
  dplyr::filter(DNA_ID != "KH_D076")

group_plot <- cy_annotation %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=1, y = DNA_ID)) + 
  geom_tile(aes(fill = Cy_Group_Name)) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = cy_group_colors, name = "Cyano Group") + 
  theme_void()+ 
  theme(legend.position = "left")


cy_bars <- cy_melt %>%
  filter(DNA_ID != "KH_D076") %>%
  mutate(DNA_ID = factor(DNA_ID, levels = rev(cy_order))) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Phylum == "p__Cyanobacteriota") %>%
  group_by(DNA_ID, Family) %>%
  summarize(Fam_Abund = sum(Abundance)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Family) %>% 
  mutate(Family = ifelse(max(Fam_Abund) > 100000, Family, "(Rare/Unknown)"),
         Family = str_remove(Family, "f__"),
         Family = ifelse(is.na(Family), "(Rare/Unknown)",Family),
         Family = ifelse(Family == "Microcystaceae_A_24132", "Microcystaceae", Family)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Fam_Abund, y = DNA_ID, fill = Family)) + 
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cyano_family_colors) + 
  labs(x = "Absolute Abundance") + 
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y= element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y= element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin()) + 
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0),
                     labels= scales::label_comma()) 

group_plot + cy_bars +
  plot_layout(nrow = 1, 
              widths = c(1,25),
              guides = "collect") & 
  theme(legend.position = "left")

# ggsave(filename = "test.png", width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
cy_rel <- cy_melt %>%
  mutate(DNA_ID = factor(DNA_ID, levels = cy_order)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Phylum == "p__Cyanobacteriota") %>%
  group_by(DNA_ID, Family) %>%
  summarize(Fam_Abund = sum(Abundance)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Family) %>% 
  mutate(Family = ifelse(max(Fam_Abund) > 5000, Family, "(Rare)"),
         Family = str_remove(Family, "f__")) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(DNA_ID) %>%
  mutate(Fam_Abund = Fam_Abund / sum(Fam_Abund)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Fam_Abund, y = DNA_ID, fill = Family)) + 
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cyano_family_colors) + 
  labs(x = "Relative Abundance") + 
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y= element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y= element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin()) + 
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0))

group_plot + cy_rel +
  plot_layout(nrow = 1, 
              widths = c(1,16),
              guides = "collect") & 
  theme(legend.position = "left")


plot(cy_dendro)

 cy_genus_abs <- 
   cy_melt %>%
  filter(DNA_ID != "KH_D076") %>%
  mutate(DNA_ID = factor(DNA_ID, levels = rev(cy_order))) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Phylum == "p__Cyanobacteriota") %>%
  group_by(DNA_ID, Family, Genus) %>%
  summarize(Fam_Abund = sum(Abundance)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Genus) %>%
  mutate(Genus = case_when(is.na(Genus) & Family == "f__Cyanobiaceae" ~"Unassigned Cyanobiaceae",
                           is.na(Genus) ~ "Unassigned",
                           max(Fam_Abund) > 50000~ Genus,
                           TRUE ~ "(Rare)"),
         Genus = str_remove(Genus, "g__")
         ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Family) %>% 
  mutate(Family = str_remove(Family, "f__"),
         Genus = factor(Genus, levels = names(cyano_genus_colors))) %>%
   ungroup() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Fam_Abund, y = DNA_ID, fill = Genus)) + 
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cyano_genus_colors) + 
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::unit_format(unit = "M", scale = 1e-6), expand = c(0,0)) + 
  labs(x = "Absolute Abundance") + 
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y= element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y= element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin()) 
 
  
 group_plot + cy_genus_abs +
  plot_layout(nrow = 1, 
              widths = c(1,16),
              guides = "collect") & 
  theme(legend.position = "left")
 

 tip_annotation_df <- 
  cyano_physeq %>%
  sample_data() %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  select(Month, DNA_ID)

tip_groups <- data.frame(DNA_ID = dendro_data(cy_dendro)$labels$label) %>%
   left_join(tip_annotation_df)

dend_data <- dendro_data(cy_dendro)

cy_dendro <- ggplot(dend_data$segments) + 
  geom_segment(aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend)) + 
  geom_point(data = dend_data$labels, aes(x = x, y = y, color = tip_groups$Month), size = 2) + 
  theme_void() +
  coord_flip() + 
  scale_y_reverse() + 
  scale_x_reverse()+
  scale_color_manual(values = month_colors) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(0.8,0,0.8,0.8)) + 
  labs(color = "Month") + 
  theme(plot.margin=grid::unit(c(0,0,0,0), "mm"))

cy_dendro +  group_plot + cy_genus_abs +
  plot_layout(nrow = 1, 
              widths = c(8,1, 16),
              guides = "collect") & 
  theme(legend.position = "left")

ggsave("test.png", width = 9, height= 8)
```

```{r three-stations, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 5}

cy_melt %>%
  dplyr::filter(Station_ID %in% c("58", "59", "G09")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Phylum == "p__Cyanobacteriota") %>%
  mutate(Genus = str_remove(Genus, "g__")) %>%
  group_by(DNA_ID, Genus, Month, Station_ID, Family) %>%
  summarize(Genus_Abund = sum(Abundance)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Genus) %>% 
  mutate(Genus = ifelse(max(Genus_Abund) < 40000, "(Rare)", Genus),
         Genus = str_remove(Genus, "g__"),
         Genus_Test = is.na(Genus),
         Genus = ifelse(is.na(Genus), "(Rare)", Genus),
         Genus = factor(Genus, levels = rev(c(
             "(Rare)",
             "Cyanobium_A_31525",
           "GFB01",
           "Synechococcus_D",
           "Vulcanococcus" ,
           "Microcystis",
            "Pseudanabaena",
           "Gloeocapsa",
           "Planktothrix",
           "Gloeothece",
           "Dolichospermum"
         )))) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Genus_Abund, y = paste(Month, Station_ID, sep = "_"), fill = Genus)) + 
  geom_col() +
  labs(x = "Absolute Abundance") + 
  theme(axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y= element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin()) + 
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0), labels = scales::label_comma()) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = cyano_genus_colors) + 
  labs(x = "Absolute Abundance (cells/ml)",
       y = "") + 
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank())
```

# Mapping Cyanos

```{r just-cyanos-mapping}

pacman::p_load(sf, terra, tmap, gstat, install = FALSE)

raw_erie <- read_sf("data/spatial_imports/hydro_p_LakeErie/hydro_p_LakeErie.shp") %>%
  st_transform(crs = "EPSG:4326")

erie_outline <- raw_erie %>%
  st_union()

trim_melted %>%
  dplyr::filter(Phylum == "p__Cyanobacteriota") %>%
  group_by(DNA_ID) %>%
  summarize(total_cyanos = sum(Abundance),
            total_phototrophs = mean(total_chl_counts),
            diff = total_cyanos - total_phototrophs) %>%
  pull(diff) %>%
  median()
  


trim_melted %>%
  dplyr::filter(Phylum == "p__Cyanobacteriota") %>%
  group_by(DNA_ID) %>%
  summarize(total_cyanos = sum(Abundance),
            total_phototrophs = mean(total_chl_counts)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = total_cyanos, y = total_phototrophs)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  ggpubr::stat_cor(method = "spearman") + 
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1) + 
  scale_y_log10() + 
  scale_x_log10()

# Cell count??
cy_genus_sf <- 
  trim_melted %>%
  dplyr::filter(Phylum == "p__Cyanobacteriota") %>%
  group_by(DNA_ID, Longitude, Latitude, Month, Phylum, total_chl_counts, Family, Genus) %>%
  summarize(Genus_Abund = sum(Abundance)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Family = str_remove(Family, "f__"),
         Genus = str_remove(Genus, "g__")) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("Longitude","Latitude"), crs = "EPSG:4326")

cy_fam_sf <- 
  cy_melt %>%
  mutate(DNA_ID = factor(DNA_ID, levels = cy_order)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Phylum == "p__Cyanobacteriota") %>%
  group_by(DNA_ID, Longitude, Latitude, Month, Family) %>%
  summarize(Fam_Abund = sum(Abundance)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Family) %>% 
  mutate(Family = ifelse(max(Fam_Abund) > 5000, Family, "(Rare)"),
         Family = str_remove(Family, "f__")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("Longitude","Latitude"), crs = "EPSG:4326")

cy_genus_sf %>%
  mutate(Month = factor(Month, levels = c("May", "August","September"))) %>%
  group_by(DNA_ID, Month) %>%
  summarize(Abundance = sum(Genus_Abund)) %>%
  ggplot() + 
  geom_sf(aes(color =Abundance/1e6), size = 3, alpha = 1) + 
  facet_wrap(~Month, ncol = 1)+
  geom_sf(data = erie_outline, fill = NA) + 
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "H", name = "All Cyanobacteria\n(million cells/ml)") + 
  theme(axis.line = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks= element_blank())

cy_genus_sf %>%
```

# Does higher cyanobacterial counts reduce richness?

```{r}

cy_melt %>%
    mutate(Cy_Group_Name = case_when(
           Cy_Group == 1 ~ "Stn 15 Aug.",
           Cy_Group == 2 ~ "Peak Bloom",
```

# DIRTY EUKARYOTIC RICHNESS

```{r}

load("data/04a_Eukaryotic_TreeBuilding/tree_euk_physeq.RData")

rared_euk <- tree_euk_physeq %>%
  prune_samples(sample_sums(.) > 500, .)

non_rare_richness <- rared_euk %>%
  estimate_richness() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("DNA_ID")

rare_richness <- rared_euk %>%
  rarefy_even_depth(500) %>%
  estimate_richness() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("DNA_ID")

inner_join(non_rare_richness, rare_richness, by = "DNA_ID") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Observed.x, y = Observed.y)) + 
  geom_point()


euk_rich <- 
  rare_richness %>%
  select(DNA_ID, Euk_Richness = Observed)

sample_data(trim_physeq) %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  left_join(euk_rich) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = total_chl_counts, y = Euk_Richness)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  facet_wrap(~Month, scales = "free") + 
  ggpubr::stat_cor(method = "spearman")
```
